caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, fabric-like object resembling a bracelet or decorative band, displayed horizontally on a plain, beige background. The band features a central motif of a brown hedgehog oriented to the right. Surrounding the hedgehog are green leaves with yellow accents and small, rounded objects in shades of orange, brown, and beige, possibly representing acorns or nuts. There is a depiction of a mushroom on the left side, illustrated in beige and reddish tones. The background of the band is a dark, nearly black color which enhances the visibility of the colorful elements. The edges of the band are bordered by a brown trim, and a metal hook is visible on the left end, suggesting a fastening mechanism. The drawing is signed "Edmond. R. Lorts" at the lower right corner of the beige background.
title: Needlepoint Bell Pull
